import sys

k = int(sys.stdin.readline())
n = 2 ** k
lines = []
for r in range(n):
    row = []
    for c in range(n):
        filled = True
        for b in range(k):
            if (r >> b) & 1 == 1 and (c >> b) & 1 == 0:
                filled = False
        row.append('#' if filled else '.')
    lines.append(''.join(row))
print('\n'.join(lines))
